title: UI pass role in the engine, in parallel with the reviewer

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Retrospective R4 (docs/review-2026-10-25-relay-retrospective.md). The hand-run relay gives UI slices a UI pass (matrix r14, rule u10); it found problems the tests passed (S33 clipping at 80x24, S84 key width). The engine has no such role, and slicer relay-run has no ui role (S87). adj 165 (roles.ui-pass, open; recommended ui-pass-with-renders).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/engine/states.go:229` (review round): start the UI pass beside the reviewer when the slice touches the UI.
- `internal/roles/prompts/ui.md` (new) and `internal/roles/roles.go`.
- `internal/tui/lineup.go`: the UI row in the lineup.
- `docs/design.md:393-425` (Roles) and `docs/design.md:183-243` (state machine).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestUIPassRunsWithReviewerOnUISlice: Files under `internal/tui` start both roles; neither waits for the other.
- TestUIPassSkippedOnEngineSlice: no UI path, no UI round.
- TestUIPassFindingsReachFixRound: its findings join the reviewer's in the fix brief.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Wait for adj 165. The UI test (which paths count as UI) matches AGENTS.md: `internal/tui` and its goldens, `docs/dashboard.md`, `internal/cli` output, or a `ui.*` adj key. The ledger step uses role reviewer with task "ID ui" until slicer has a ui role.

S31 preflight (2026-10-25): `ork run ork S78` lists reviewer and gate twice, because the lineup takes matrix row r14 (the UI pass, also role reviewer) as the reviewer's fallback. With this slice, r14 runs only as the UI pass on UI slices and is not a reviewer or gate fallback; also drop an entry identical to the one before it in any fallback chain (see S49's duplicate-row note). Until slicer s392 adds a ui role, tell r14 apart by its note or a matrix rule.

adj 165 is decided (ui-pass-with-renders; renders are S121). Owner decisions (2026-10-26 session, AskUserQuestion): (1) ork finds the UI pass row through the matrix rule that names 'UI pass row (rNN)' (u10 today); that row runs only as the UI pass on UI slices, never as a reviewer or gate fallback; switch to slicer's ui role when s392 lands. (2) The prompt is ork's own internal/roles/prompts/ui.md (80x24, ASCII and mono, clipping, key hints), vendor-neutral, no plugin skill.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: go test -race ./internal/engine ./internal/roles ./internal/tui; go vet; gofmt -l; slicer check; adj lint.
